name: KernelHarbor
description: Linux kernel security monitoring with Falco, falcosidekick, heuristic detection, and optional LLM analysis

analysisAddr.description: gRPC address for the KernelHarbor analysis service

autoStart.description: Auto-start sidecar processes on gateway startup

falcoRulesPath.description: Path to Falco rules file (default: rules/kernelharbor-rules.yaml)

falcoSidekickPort.description: Port for falcosidekick to listen on for events from Falco

falcoWebhookPort.description: Port for the plugin webhook receiver (receives from falcosidekick)

signerPort.description: Port for the HMAC signing proxy (between falcosidekick and webhook)

signingSecret.description: Shared secret for HMAC-SHA256 signing of Falco events (empty = disabled)
